product_one_liner.value: Verifiable automates provider credentialing, primary-source verification and ongoing network monitoring for healthcare organizations.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link or public plans were found; the site directs prospective buyers to contact the company or book a demo.

employee_band.notes: Public company profiles report approximately 136–138 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The blog contains industry, product and marketing content; no two engineer-authored posts explaining product implementation were established.

public_docs.notes: Public API documentation includes getting started, authentication, providers, verifications, monitoring, integrations and webhooks.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job index lists Customer Success Manager, Enterprise Customer Success Manager and Solutions Engineer; none is a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The disclosure names Claude for code generation, evaluation, testing and workflow assistance connected with its platform and services; it does not specify a CredAgent model version.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims SOC 2 Type 2 compliance and annual independent SOC 2 audits.

last_funding.notes: Uses the public announcement month: July 10, 2023. The round was led by Craft Ventures.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was in 2023, before the May 9, 2025 start of the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Enterprise Account Executive posting and application form remain accessible, although the role is absent from the main job index.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest launch announcement found was CredAgent on February 26, 2026, before the May 9, 2026 start of the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying change was verified for November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026, and the About page does not provide a complete dated leadership roster.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The BDR posting explicitly refers to maintaining prospect data in Verifiable’s own Salesforce instance.
